description: CUSTOMER SETUP — run (or RESUME) the checkpointed provisioning saga for a setup session you own: exactly one workspace with its client type, owner membership, roster record and the exact versioned map binding; returns…

custom_campaign.description: Explicit custom setup identity for recovery. Existing campaign/model identities are never overwritten. Read custom_campaign_readiness before submitting.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: provision_customer
